subject.title: docs: respect configured Crabbox provider for agent tests

question: Should an eligible machine-local `CRABBOX_PROVIDER` override the repository Blacksmith Testbox fallback for ordinary trusted heavy proof?
rationale: This changes the intended validation environment for existing operators and therefore cannot be settled solely by implementation correctness, although the current member-authored revision and live proof support the change.

options.title: Approve preference precedence
options.body: Honor explicit task choice, then eligible `CRABBOX_PROVIDER`, then Blacksmith fallback, and update every conflicting active skill before merge.

options.title: Keep Testbox mandatory
options.body: Preserve explicit Blacksmith Testbox routing for ordinary trusted heavy proof and limit inherited providers to task-specific exceptions.

recommendation.title: Approve preference precedence
recommendation.body: Honor explicit task choice, then eligible `CRABBOX_PROVIDER`, then Blacksmith fallback, and update every conflicting active skill before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current root Testbox-default policy traces to their remote-runner policy work, while `hxy91819` has supplied the proposed replacement direction and proof.
